title: Read the Schedule Board
callout: Scheduling — know who's on duty, anytime

shots.say: See who's working every shift this week, at a glance.
shots.caption: Your schedule at a glance

shots.say: Tap Schedule, at the bottom of the screen. The board shows every shift this week, colored by whether it still needs people.
shots.caption: Tap Schedule
shots.speak: Tap Sked-yool, at the bottom of the screen. The board shows every shift this week, colored by whether it still needs people.

shots.say: Red means two or more seats are open. Amber means one. Green means the shift is full.
shots.caption: Red 2+ open · Amber 1 open · Green full

shots.say: Tap a day to see who's on each shift, and which seats are still open.
shots.caption: Tap a day: who's on, what's open

shots.say: Filter to the shifts that need staffing, or to just your own.
shots.caption: Needs staffing · My shifts

shots.say: Your own shifts are blue, so you always know when you're on duty.
shots.caption: Blue = you're on duty

shots.say: Know who's on duty, any time.
shots.caption: Know who's on duty
